description:
Make pinned target inspection read its blobs through the module's object reader, so one `cat-file` answer parser remains.

## Background

- `GitCheckout::inspect_pinned_targets` reads blobs with a write-all-then-read `cat-file --batch` and its own answer parser, moved from the revision resolver (`read_blob_batch` and `parse_cat_file_batch`).
- The module's object reader answers the same requests through one process with its own parser.
- The pinned-inspection cases in the module suite count processes per inspection.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `inspect_pinned_targets` reads its blobs through one object reader, and the write-all-then-read batch and its parser no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: The pinned-inspection cases keep their results, process counts and subcommands.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Pinned target inspection reads blobs through the object reader
